name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Girls, families, communities and stakeholders involved in girl-child survival, protection and education
eligibility: Implemented through government and community interventions under Mission Shakti.
benefits: Promotes survival, protection, education and empowerment of the girl child; focuses on behavioural and social change rather than a direct cash benefit to individuals.
documents: Scheme-specific documents are required only for linked services/benefits
application_process: Access through district/state implementation of Mission Shakti and related government programmes.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
